text.en:
Any provisions of existing executive and/or
administrative orders as are inconsistent with the provi-
sions of this Order are hereby repealed.

This Order shall take effect on March 15, 1955.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-five,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the ninth.
RaMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philippines
By the President:
FRED RUIZ CASTRO
Procutive Secretary
